Distinct from the configurable connection_teardown_timeout orphan grace (FR-031). Backfill a note into FR-014.

proposals.after: FR-014: ... + The block for DisconnectAck MUST be bounded by a fixed DISCONNECT_ACK_TIMEOUT (hardcoded 500 ms, src/actor.rs:37); a lost ack makes the actor give up rather than hang. proposals.rationale: src/actor.rs:576-591: on create_memory_tier_entry AlreadyExists, success is counted only when entry_size(key) == len; a differing size discards the private slot (memory_tier.remove) and marks the key unsatisfied, never evicting the resident entry. FR-006 said only 'a racing AlreadyExists counts as success', omitting the size qualification. Documented in knowledge/size-mismatch-handling.md. Backfill FR-006.
proposals.before: FR-006: ... release_write(key) (a racing AlreadyExists counts as success); on failure/peer-exit ...
proposals.after: FR-006: ... A racing AlreadyExists counts as success only when the existing entry's size equals the landing slot length (entry_size(key) == len); a differing size is treated as unsatisfied - discard the private slot (memory_tier.remove) and never evict/overwrite the resident entry.
